issues: This is an inspection-body accreditation scope (Область аккредитации органа инспекции), not a testing-laboratory range table: the source table has no indicator/range/unit columns. Columns are №, Наименование объекта, Код ОК, Код ТН ВЭД ТС, Вид/тип инспекции и нормативные документы (col.5), Документы устанавливающие методы инспекции (col.6). 'indicator' field repurposed to hold the bold inspection-type subheading (e.g. Санитарно-эпидемиологическая экспертиза) that groups each set of normative documents within a numbered row; 'norm_doc' holds col.5's normative-document list only, while col.6's method/standardization documents are preserved in raw_row_text but not split into a separate field (schema has none). No ТР ТС section headings appear anywhere in the document, so tr_section is null on every row per the rules. Document is a 6-page PDF scan of a double-sided 3-sheet (лист 1-3) original: pages 2 and 4 are blank versos, and page 6 is the experts'-signature page (Эксперт по аккредитации / Технические эксперты) with no table content; all 6 pages were rendered and read. Pages were physically rotated 90° (landscape table on a portrait scan) and were re-rendered upright (+90°) at 170dpi before transcription. Rows continuing across the page 1->3->5 break (row 1.1's normative-document lists) were merged into single logical entries per inspection type, not duplicated. No numeric ranges, no illegible text encountered.
